name: Redirect Remover for Reddit/Imgur Images
description: Prevents redirect of Reddit and Imgur image files to full page. For example, a link to https://i.imgur.com/{whatever}.jpg will load the image; https://i.redd.it/{whatever}.jpg will as well; and https://preview.redd.it/{whatever}?junk will redirect to the shorter i.redd.it image. Written declaratively, no scripts.
